changelog.title: Analytics Sync Fixed
changelog.description: Student progress now syncs to Firestore in real-time. Instructor dashboard analytics fully operational.

changelog.title: EduScan Auto-Healing System
changelog.description: Content integrity enforcement tool with auto-fix capabilities. Detects and repairs broken paths, naming violations, and orphaned files.

changelog.title: 992 Files Standardized
changelog.description: All house content renamed to {house}-{name}.{type}.html convention. Consistent, discoverable, machine-parseable.

changelog.title: 237 Files Reorganized
changelog.description: Labs, quizzes, and tools moved to proper type directories. Clean separation by content type.

changelog.title: Full Rollback Capability
changelog.description: All renames and reorganizations can be undone with single commands. Safe experimentation.

changelog.title: GitHub Actions CI Pipeline
changelog.description: EduScan runs on every push/PR. Reports uploaded as artifacts, PR comments with issue summaries.

changelog.title: Content Health Dashboard
changelog.description: status.json generated on every scan. Critical/High/Medium/Low issue counts at a glance.

changelog.title: EduScan Documentation
changelog.description: Comprehensive README with CLI usage, fixer tools, issue codes, and architecture overview.

changelog.title: Zero Broken LearningPaths
changelog.description: All module hrefs now resolve to existing files. LP-001 count: 0.
